meta_title: A new way to chat - Pepo
meta_description: A clean, standalone chat client for Twitch. With support for 7TV, BTTV, and FFZ emotes, followed channels, and lots of planned features. Cross-platform, open source.
hero_subtitle: A clean, and easy to use chat client for Twitch. With support for 7TV, BTTV, and FFZ emotes.
hero_feature_emotes: 7TV, BTTV and FFZ emotes, out of the box
hero_feature_platforms: Runs on macOS, Windows, Linux, and mobile (soon™)
features_intro: Take a look at all the available features, including currently planned ones
demo_window_label: Interactive preview of the pepo app

feature_group_chat_blurb: Out of the box support for the most popular third-party emote providers.
feature_chat_decorations: Native Twitch chat events: first-time chatters, resubs, and watch streaks
feature_group_channels_blurb: See who's live and control how you organize your following
feature_channels_live_sorting: Live status, viewer counts and stream info
feature_channels_live_notifications: Alerts when favorite channels go live
feature_group_app_blurb: A standalone, cross-platform app, always free
feature_group_events_blurb: Planned tools for channel activity and moderation.
feature_events_activity: A real-time feed of support and moderation events
feature_events_deleted_messages: Choose how deleted messages are handled
feature_events_support_activity: Gifted subs, Hype Trains and other support activity

build_intro: Requires Rust, Node.js, pnpm and GNU Make.
